result.topic_en: Scattered jottings: a classification of Gaussian primes into four classes (0–3) relative to the modulus 3+2i, a small table of a−b / a+b factors by class, polynomial expressions in φ, differential-type relations in p, q, geometric sketches, and unrelated words (Lochhausen, Themistocles, Lampedusa, Parnassus).
